## PhyloTreeProps.leafSpacing property

Vertical pixels per leaf. When set, the tree is laid out that tall (instead of fitting `height`<!-- -->) and the view scrolls through it — a large tree stays readable. Ignored for `"radial"`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
leafSpacing?: number;
```
